issued_by: Lead (agent), not a human approver and not the A5 reviewer

written_by.why: a reader must be able to tell which writer produced this record; a GO whose writer cannot be identified cannot be distinguished from one typed by hand

byte_verifier_is_a_hard_precondition: this record was refused unless a fresh mechanical verifier round reported O0_BYTES_BOUND_MECHANICALLY with zero failures over exactly these dossier bytes, written after the dossier and archived where it cannot be overwritten

optimizer_carried_forward.counting_rule: the latest AUTHORIZATION_CUMULATIVE record is the floor because its counters already include what it carried forward; only batch-local records it did not absorb are added, so nothing is counted twice

optimizer_budget_note: the optimizer authorization is exhausted by design; this record authorizes no further optimizer start and cannot propose or admit a new design
verification_budget_source: read back from o0_preregistration.json o0_final.separate_budget; a budget typed into the runner would not be pre-registered and is refused

rows.label: final-baseline-r1
rows.note: spent before the crash on a case whose wake count was 2, below the admission mesh of 8; the polar it produced is real but the mesh is not the admitted mesh, so it can never be admitted and must never be re-run under this label

rows.label: final-baseline-r2
rows.note: spent before the crash on a case whose wake count was 2, below the admission mesh of 8; same disposition as final-baseline-r1

rows.label: final-baseline-wake16
rows.note: the pre-registered 16-wake-node probe for the baseline; it completed before the crash and its paid output is on the disk, but the charge never ran because the charge used to happen after the run. It is charged here, it is a probe and is never admitted, and it is not re-run because it already happened

repair.reason: the crashed O0-FINAL run charged its starts after the run, so the third paid start never reached the ledger, and the two starts that did reach it were labelled kind=wake although they were repeats configured with 2 wake nodes. Both facts are corrected here from the paid case directories.

kind_corrections.label: final-baseline-wake16
kind_corrections.why: the run completed and the paid output is on the disk but the charge never happened

repair.total_charged_is_unchanged_in_kind_but_n: the old ledger claimed 2 starts and 26 internal cases; the true bill is 3 starts and 39 internal cases, all of them already spent, none of them re-runnable
repair.not_a_new_budget: this repair adds no permission to spend. It only makes the already-spent bill visible, and the caps are the repaired verification caps that include the five starts still to be spent.

verification_spend_carried_forward.budget_is_gross: the pre-registered 8 starts and 104 internal cases are the whole of the verification step, gross. Three of those starts and 39 internal cases were already spent before this GO; the five starts and 65 internal cases that remain are what this GO actually authorizes, and the ledger decides that, not this paragraph
verification_spend_carried_forward.how_the_remainder_is_enforced: the runner reads the ledger back on start-up and refuses any charge past the pre-registered cap, so the already-spent starts are subtracted automatically rather than by arithmetic in a comment

caps_are_separate_from_the_optimizer_cap: these starts are itemized verification work; they never extend the O0 search budget and may not be used to look for a better design
not_authorized: any further optimizer start or any new design proposal
any change to the lift tolerance, target lift or reference quantities
re-use of the O0 optimizer GO for verification work
conditions: the verification ledger is charged before the case is evaluated and persists after every charge; a crash restarts owing what was already spent
wake-probe cases at 16 wake nodes are never admitted and never counted as labels
no retry of an interrupted verification start; an interrupted start stays charged
lift tolerance 1e-3 is never relaxed and no interpolated row may be admitted
resulting verdict is one of the four pre-registered verdict strings, never 'PASS'
